answer: Make every agent identity carry a slow-vesting bond: a refundable deposit locked at creation, released in small tranches only after honest, verifiable attestations. An attacker cannot whisper a thousand fake identities into existence, because each needs its own bond, waiting period, and clean record; one cheat slashes that identity's remaining bond. Cost scales with every clone, like cutting timber one tree at a time, while honest agents recover their bond in full. A fake nebula of clones collapses under its own funding and delay, since rewards arrive only after vesting.
